Eveready, India's leading battery company, was amongst the foremost players to make a foray into the 'Rechargeable Batteries' segment with its 'Eveready Ultima' brand of batteries and chargers.
Genesis of the rechargeable battery: The original rechargeable batteries were manufactured with Nickel-cadmium (Ni-Cd), but the technology soon switched over to use Nickel-metal hydride (Ni-MH) because cadmium is harmful to the environment. Eveready strongly believes in protecting the environment and manufactures an environmentally friendly Ni-MH range of rechargeable batteries.
Eveready Advantage: Cost-effective, a one-time buy, rechargeable batteries can be reused hundreds of times. Eveready Rechargeable batteries can last for a very long time if used properly. Environment-friendly. While many batteries can contain corrosive materials that have an adverse effect on health and the environment, Eveready batteries are manufactured following strict processes and guidelines, and are environmentally friendly.
Excellent Capacity: We use Ni-MH batteries, which have 30-40% higher energy storage capacity than a standard nickel-cadmium battery. Chargers Our chargers also come with intelligent charging, overcharge and deep discharge protection and are ideal to use with Eveready Ultima rechargeable batteries. Conserving Energy Rechargeable batteries can be used repeatedly, which means that fewer of these need to be manufactured, and thereby the operational footprint is considerably less. Eveready Ultima's usage took the rechargeable battery market in India by storm, with its world-class, value-for-money product range. The range comprises the best rechargeable batteries and chargers for digital cameras, toys, wireless mouse and MP3 players, etc.
